pages.text: The Storage Terminal is the direct resource interface. Its grid grows with the window and scrolls when the selected resource group has more visible types than fit.
See $(l:auto_storage:recipes)Recipe Catalog$() for the exact crafting layout.

Use the left resource selector for Items, Fluids, Energy, Gases, Processing, or Other registered addon kinds. All shows every available group together. Energy includes FE, Fuel/Brew, Mana, and Source; Processing contains only accumulated station work; Other contains Axe Uses and unclassified addon values. Fluids use teal frames, Energy violet, Gas/Other blue, and Processing amber. Item view supports normal extraction and inventory insertion. Other views use display-only representatives.

The search field parses ordinary names, @mod, and #tag. A bare @, #, or $ behaves like an empty search. Click outside to release Search without clearing its filter. Auto Focus gives Search initial focus only when the terminal opens; Search Sync separately controls the installed recipe viewer (EMI or JEI).

Sort by Name, Quantity, Mod, or ID and choose ascending or descending order. Variants with different properties stay separate. Middle-click the resource selector to return to Items. For Craftable recipes, Transform conversions, and Stations, upgrade to the $(l:auto_storage:crafting_terminal)Crafting Terminal$().
